questions.question: What does Isaiah 59 say has separated the people from God?
options: The ruin of the holy temple

questions.question: What does God do when he sees there is no one to intervene, in Isaiah 59?
options: He waits patiently for the people to repent of their sins on their own
His own arm brings salvation; he puts on righteousness as a breastplate
He sends out a prophet to call all the people to a great and solemn fast
He raises up a foreign king from afar to come and deliver his people
questions.answer: His own arm brings salvation; he puts on righteousness as a breastplate

questions.question: Isaiah 59 says justice is turned back, and truth has stumbled in the public squares.
